args.description: ONE broad squat irregular MOSSY BOULDER wrapped in thick curving brown TREE ROOTS, LEFT lower corner decoration for a 2D enchanted forest. The lower two thirds of the canvas are one cohesive heavy blue-gray stone outcrop with a broad planted base, large asymmetrical quiet facets, rounded irregular silhouette. NOT a rock pillar or stone tower. NOT one small rock above another small rock. One thick exposed wooden root curls over the rock shoulder and sweeps across its face, with a complete tapering root rising along the left edge above the boulder. Root ends sweep toward the right along the ground. Moss rests on stone ledges, sparse broad leaves, a few red and pale mushrooms attached at crevices. Substantial stone first, strong wood second, small foliage last. Designed as a natural grounded corner formation, no detached rocks or floating fragments. Simple chunky native pixel clusters, dark crisp contours, top-left light, clean restrained shading. No UI or background, no ground tile, no blur. All tips and base remain fully within canvas with transparent margin.
args.palette_name: Dungeon Matcher enchanted forest material ramps

reference_images.usage: Lower-left composition inspiration: large integrated mossy stone and thick roots. Ignore UI, text, floating wisps.
